title.narrative: Partnership Development Project between TAMSA TAMIDA and IMCC TAMIDA

description.narrative: The Partnership Development Project (PDP) between IMCC TAMIDA and TAMSA TAMIDA aims to strengthen the existing partnership by reviewing and updating the common vision and partnership agreement, enhancing project management skills, and deepening the understanding of sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) through workshops, debates, and capacity-building activities. The PDP includes an evaluation of the ongoing pilot project in Tanzania, carried out by TAMSA TAMIDA, assessing its progress and impact. This holistic approach ensures that the partnership's foundation is solidified preparing for the upcoming partnership project through brainstorming, application development, and effective project management strategies.
